<!--
You do not need any access to this repository to help here. It is public: fork
it, push a branch to your fork, and open a pull request. The pull request runs
the full test suite. Filing an issue first is welcome but not required.

A bare `#NNN` means this repository.

Do not pair a close/fix/resolve verb directly with an issue reference unless you
mean to close it, since that fires from an issue body too. Write "part of" or
"refs" instead. Break the adjacency rather than hunting for a gentler verb.

A security problem goes through private vulnerability reporting, not here; see
SECURITY.md.
-->

## What you ran

<!--
Verbatim, please, including the command line. A retyped approximation of a
command is a different command, and the difference is usually the bug.
-->

## What you expected, and what happened

<!--
Both halves. Paste the output rather than describing it. If a store you
expected to pass a conformance property failed it, or a store you expected to
fail one passed it, say which property and which store.
-->

## Does it reproduce from a clean checkout?

<!--
Yes / no / did not try are all useful answers. If it only reproduces against
your own store or deployment, say so: that narrows the cause, and it may mean
the store does not qualify rather than that the suite is wrong.
-->
